title: Home Program Adherence Gap
dataSources: MedBridge exercises (`medbridge:exercise`), PT clinic sessions (`pt:session`), Hinge Health sessions (`hingehealth:session`), rehab range-of-motion logs (`rehab:rom`), and pain diary entries (`pain:diary`).
app: MedBridge exercise completions, clinic PT session exports, Hinge Health digital sessions, ROM measurement logs, and pain diary entries forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=hingehealth:session program_name=* completion_pct=*
| stats avg(completion_pct) as avg_completion, count as sessions by program_name
| eval adherence_gap=round(100-avg_completion,1)
| where adherence_gap>25
| sort - adherence_gap
description: Highlights Hinge Health programs whose average completion percentage falls materially below full adherence.
value: Digital PT only works when sessions actually get finished; partial completions hide quiet dropout.
implementation: Capture `completion_pct` on every Hinge Health session and review programs with large adherence gaps weekly.
visualization: Bar chart of adherence gap percentage by program.
grandmaExplanation: It counts which rehab programs you keep starting but not quite finishing.
